_comment: Pipeline canary for @rightkit/release (scripts/ci/rk-release-canary.mjs). Each entry names one app config the candidate's `right-release doctor` is run against, beside the registry baseline, on the platforms listed. repoDir is the checkout directory under the host's workspace root; configPath is relative to repoDir (its directory is the app root). Platform ios runs on the Mac leg. blocking:false apps are report-only: their findings never turn the canary red. Matrix changes are reviewed with the canary scripts; the canary receipt binds this file's digest.

rust._comment: The doctor runs cargo metadata --no-deps --offline; the leg puts this rustup toolchain's bin first on PATH, because the build-control cargo shim refuses the canary's scratch exports (RK_NOT_PRIMARY_CHECKOUT). Nothing is compiled.

win32.nodeNote: node is not on the ssh PATH on the Dell (Get-Command node finds nothing, C:\Program Files\nodejs does not exist); the nvm install matching the Mac's v26.8.1 is pinned. Re-verify with: win "Test-Path '<node>'" if the Dell's nvm is reorganised.
